g.text: Recommended Global Command Structure - Confirmed Agent Help
Confirmed target-only global design; green marks the Help metadata path.
Repeated collaborators are grouped, not omitted.
Help has no catalog formatting, model call, or refresh.
Help exposes no prompt or binding details; reads serialize with Agent publication.
Core/application services are singleton; response data is request-scoped.
HelpData belongs to runtimeapi.dto.command, not the Service package.
RuntimePorts includes singleton services and execution-scoped Session objects.
